page_title: STR 2-1 PSG | Strasbourg v PSG 03/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle and it's Axel Tape (PSG) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+7' The linesman raises his flag. Goncalo Ramos (PSG) is adjudged offside.

90+5' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Goncalo Ramos (PSG) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic pulls off a comfortable save.
90+3' Desire Doue (PSG) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
90+3' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has a clear sight and sees a foul from Guela Doue (Strasbourg).
90+1' Bradley Barcola (PSG) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Djordje Petrovic makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
89' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
87' PSG try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
86' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
85' He should have done better. Goncalo Ramos (PSG) is afforded space to connect with a Desire Doue cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well wide of the left post.
83' Axel Tape (PSG) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
83' Desire Doue (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
81' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
80' Substitution. Samuel Amo-Ameyaw has come on for Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) will replace Felix Lemarechal.
79' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) is being substituted because of an injury. Liam Rosenior sends Abakar Sylla on the pitch.
79' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) fires a volley towards goal, but the ball sails well wide of the left post.
78' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
77' The referee awards a corner and Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) goes over to take it.
77' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Strasbourg get a corner.
76' Desire Doue (PSG) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
73' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post.
72' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
71' A precise low pass is received by Desire Doue (PSG), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
69' Liam Rosenior is forced to make a change. Mamadou Sarr is unable to continue due to injury, Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) comes on.
68' Looks like Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
67' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Djordje Petrovic comes off the line to clear the ball away.
65' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
64' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

64' Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick. Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
62' Problems for Liam Rosenior as Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Abdoul Ouattara replaces him.
62' Substitution. Fabian Ruiz in, Joao Neves (PSG) out.
61' Bradley Barcola (PSG) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
60' Bradley Barcola (PSG) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
59' Bradley Barcola (PSG) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
58' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
57' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
56' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle and signals a foul after Senny Mayulu (PSG) brought his opponent down.
53' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg will take a throw-in.
46' 2 - 1 Bradley Barcola (PSG) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Djordje Petrovic with a strike into the right side of the goal. He makes it 2:1.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Lucas Hernandez (PSG) is replaced by Noham Kamara.
46' The game is over for Kang-In Lee (PSG). Desire Doue comes on for the second half.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' 2 - 0 Goal! Habib Diarra pulls the ball back for Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the top left corner. 2:0.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
42' Kang-In Lee (PSG) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
41' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
38' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is adjudged offside.
37' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) jumps into a tackle and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem signals a foul.
36' Lovely run from Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
35' What a big chance! Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
31' The injury to Lucas Hernandez (PSG) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
30' The resulting set piece from PSG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
28' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Djordje Petrovic is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
25' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Matvey Safonov is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
23' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.

20' 1 - 0 This is really unlucky! Lucas Hernandez (PSG) attempted to clear the ball away after the opposition’s corner kick into the box, but instead miskicked the clearance and put it into his own net, specifically into the bottom right corner. He won't enjoy watching the highlights later.
19' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Strasbourg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

19' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Strasbourg will take a corner.
15' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Bradley Barcola (PSG) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
9' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
7' Kang-In Lee (PSG) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
6' PSG take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
6' Senny Mayulu (PSG) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
3' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Goncalo Ramos (PSG), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and PSG will have the kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem was nominated as the referee for this game.
